name: cargo

allocations.name: cargo
allocations.purpose: Cargo registries, git sources and tool state

notes: Before first Cargo use, create an empty config.toml through sandboxed file tools only when missing. Preserve project .cargo/config.toml and lockfile. The compiler/rustup installation is existing host state: inspect access first and review narrowly scoped reads if hidden. Do not copy credentials.toml, install/update rustup, or change global configuration. RUSTUP_HOME must continue to identify the existing explicitly readable toolchain; CARGO_HOME must not relocate rustup. target remains project-local. State is isolated per checkout.
